title: Class-Incremental Continual Learning:
prompt: **Class-Incremental Continual Learning:** Your classifier initially predicts 50 product categories, and next month the business adds 10 new categories without wanting to retrain from scratch on old data. How do cosine classifier heads and exemplar memory buffers work?
